text:
Samir Kumar: Morning — I'm Samir, joining Eng today. Quick hit: Okta shows 'Approval pending' and I don't have a Gmail account yet. I uploaded my SSH public key in the onboarding form but git clone fails with permission denied. 1Password also says 'invite pending'. Can someone nudge approvals or grant temp access? Thanks!

IT Help: Hey Samir, welcome! 👋 I can grant a temporary alias so you can get going. Can you paste the last 6 of your employee ID here? Also please DM your full SSH pubkey instead of posting it in-channel.

Samir Kumar: ah sorry, didn't mean to paste the full key earlier. the id is 234568. DM sent with the key.

Camille (People Ops): Thanks @IT Help — I'm approving Samir's Okta invite now. This sometimes sits in our queue if an approver missed the email. Approving -> should be provisioned in a couple minutes.

Okta Bot: User samir.kumar@redwood.com provisioning started. Status: processing -> active.

IT Help: Done — created temp alias samir.temp@redwood.com. Try signing into Google with that address and run the password reset flow (you'll get a setup link). That should unblock Drive and 1Password invites until the official email is active.

Samir Kumar: Logged into temp alias and can access Drive, thanks. Git still failing though: `Permission denied (publickey)`.

Michael (Eng): @Samir quick checklist: 1) ensure the same SSH pubkey is added to your GitHub account (https://github.com/settings/keys), 2) run `ssh -T git@github.com -vvv` and paste the last 10 lines here if it still fails. Often it's an agent/key mismatch.

Samir Kumar: Ran `ssh -T git@github.com -vvv` — getting `debug1: Offering public key: /home/samir/.ssh/id_ed25519` then `Permission denied (publickey)`. The key I DM'd matches the one in the onboarding form.

IT Help: Looks like GitHub doesn't have the key yet. I can add it to the org temporarily if you want. @1Password Admin — we also need to make sure 1Password invite maps to final email once Okta finishes.

1Password Admin: Invite resent to samir.temp@redwood.com and again to samir.kumar@redwood.com now that Okta shows active. Please accept the invite from whichever inbox you have access to; we'll convert the seat when the official address is fully provisioned.

IT Help: Added the SSH key to the GitHub org as a temporary deploy key for samir. Try cloning again.

Samir Kumar: clone works now — thanks! 1Password accepted via temp alias and I can see the team vault. Everything else seems unblocked. Appreciate the fast triage :rocket:

Camille (People Ops): Great — closing the loop. I've forwarded the final provisioning confirmation to People Ops logs. If anything else pops up during your first-day setup ping this thread or DM @IT Help. Welcome aboard! :tada:
